ios.desc:
Happy to see you here. Use Puff Counter to cut back at a pace you can keep, not just to feel good for one day.

Believe me: tomorrow can be different.

It's a simple cycle: Calculate your personal week plan → Track every day → See your small steps add up over a week → Stay motivated → Start the next week stronger.

Puff Counter already has everything you need.

A PLAN THAT ADAPTS TO YOU
Your weekly limit is recalculated from what you actually smoked or vaped — stay under it and you taper faster, slip over and the next step stays realistic.

Ready to take control of your smoking habits? Puff Counter is your intelligent companion on the way to a healthier life. From your own numbers, we build a personalized reduction plan that actually fits you — and recalculate it every week as you go.

Most people don't quit overnight, and that's okay. Puff Counter gives you a daily limit that tapers down week by week, so you cut back at a pace your brain and body can handle.

WHY CHOOSE PUFF COUNTER? • Smart goal setting — a reduction plan built from your own data, recalculated weekly • Visual progress tracking — see your journey in beautiful analytics • Achievement system — stay motivated with meaningful rewards • Money-saved calculator — watch your savings grow daily • Privacy-first design — your data stays yours

WHY PEOPLE LOVE IT
 • Count every puff with a single tap — no more guessing 
• A smart daily limit that lowers gradually, week by week 
• Urge-surfing tool with guided breathing to ride out cravings 
• Streaks, challenges, and an on-track score to keep you going 
• See the real money you're saving, day by day 
• Watch your health recover with milestone tracking 
• Home and lock-screen widgets keep progress in sight
 • A week-by-week journey that shows how far you've come

FREE AND PLUS
Counting puffs, the widgets, Apple Watch, the craving tool and challenges are free. Puff Counter Plus unlocks the week-by-week plan, your full streak history, statistics, the recovery timeline and money saved.

NOT MEDICAL ADVICE
Puff Counter is a habit tracker, not medical care. If you use nicotine replacement or medication to quit, follow your clinician's plan. For adults only.

As the developer of Puff Counter AI, I hit my first $1K in revenue within a month. But this is just the beginning—I’ve been refining the product using AI, behavioral science, and data-driven monetization strategies. Here’s what worked for me and how I’m scaling further:

How I Reached $1K in a Month with My Puff Counter AI App

1. Solving a Real Problem with AI & Behavioral Science
Most vaping trackers simply log usage, but they don’t help users change behavior.

I designed AI-powered reduction plans based on BJ Fogg’s behavior model, ensuring users reduce puffs gradually and sustainably.

The app personalizes recommendations using prompt engineering, analyzing the user’s patterns to provide tailored reduction strategies.

Instead of generic tips, every user gets a dynamic AI-generated plan based on their onboarding data.

Use Apple Shortcuts and Siri to add new puff, Even app is close you can add puff just click back off device (People love that easy life trick use them !)

2. Leveraging Subscription Model & A/B Testing with RevenueCat
Instead of a one-time purchase, I launched a freemium model with RevenueCat v2 paywalls.

The free tier provides core tracking, while premium unlocks AI-powered insights, personalized reduction plans, and savings calculations.

A/B testing with RevenueCat helped me fine-tune the best-performing paywall design. Early results? A 20% increase in trial-to-paid conversions.

And you can see, I have many A/B Test not one!
